_note: Shot types and scenes for the dashboard. Text is style-neutral: fit, shoulder, pockets and zip come from catalogue/ through the compiler, never from here. Keep every compiled prompt inside CLAUDE.md's 120-220 words (tests/test_specs.py checks every combination). On-model recipes take background and lighting from the chosen scene; packshots ignore the scene. requires_decoration: the shot has nothing to show without a design. pipeline/specs.py adds the catalogue's "<shoulder> shoulder seams" to must_show (in place of a generic "the shoulder seams") unless shows_shoulders is false: a framing that leaves the shoulders out.

packshot-front.label: Packshot, front
packshot-front.purpose: Front-view packshot of a single hoodie as a ghost-mannequin catalogue shot, body shape filled out

camera.framing: whole garment centred with even margins

packshot-front.lighting: soft, even overhead softbox light showing the fleece texture
packshot-front.background: seamless light grey backdrop with a soft shadow below the hem

packshot-back.label: Packshot, back
packshot-back.purpose: Back-view packshot of a single hoodie as a ghost-mannequin catalogue shot, body shape filled out

camera.angle: straight on from behind at chest height
camera.framing: whole garment centred with even margins

packshot-back.lighting: soft, even overhead softbox light showing the fleece texture
packshot-back.background: seamless light grey backdrop with a soft shadow below the hem

on-model-front.label: On model, front
on-model-front.purpose: On-model front view showing the fit and heavyweight drape

camera.angle: at chest height, slightly off centre

on-model-front.lighting: soft window-style key light from camera left
on-model-front.pose: standing relaxed, one hand in a front pocket

on-model-back.label: On model, back
on-model-back.purpose: On-model back view showing the fit and heavyweight drape
on-model-back.lighting: soft window-style key light from camera left
on-model-back.pose: standing relaxed, back to camera, head turned slightly

decoration-closeup.label: Decoration close-up
decoration-closeup.purpose: Close-up detail shot of the decoration, showing its stitch or print texture and the surrounding fleece

camera.angle: straight on, slightly above the decoration
camera.framing: the decoration filling most of the frame with a little fabric around it

decoration-closeup.lighting: soft raking side light showing the decoration and fleece texture
decoration-closeup.background: the garment fabric fills the frame
must_show: the decoration crisp and fully in frame

flat-lay.label: Flat lay
flat-lay.purpose: Flat-lay shot of a single hoodie, sleeves relaxed at the sides, body shape clearly visible

camera.framing: whole garment centred with even margins

flat-lay.lighting: soft, even overhead daylight showing the fleece texture

studio-grey.label: Studio grey
studio-grey.lighting: soft, even softbox light with gentle front fill

warm-studio.label: Warm studio
warm-studio.lighting: soft window-style key light from camera left

concrete-daylight.label: Concrete and daylight
concrete-daylight.background: unpainted concrete wall in an urban courtyard
concrete-daylight.lighting: soft overcast daylight with gentle fill

warm-cafe.label: Warm cafe
